scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix orchestrator && npm install --prefix services/calendar-service && npm install --prefix services/task-service && npm install --prefix services/email-service
scripts.start:client: wait-on http://localhost:3000/health && npm --prefix client run dev:ui
scripts.start:backend: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta" --names "calendar,task,email,orchestrator" "node services/calendar-service/src/index.js" "node services/task-service/src/index.js" "node services/email-service/src/index.js" "npm --prefix orchestrator start"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --prefix-colors "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" --names "calendar,task,email,orchestrator,client" "node services/calendar-service/src/index.js" "node services/task-service/src/index.js" "node services/email-service/src/index.js" "npm --prefix orchestrator start" "npm run start:client"
